ops.title: Avoid duplicate document snapshot reads for state-independent edits
ops.description: Responsible lane: /root/current_host_relief. EditDoc currently decodes the full cached document for preflight, unconditional AppendFrom.LoadAt, and writer extension even when the mask is independent of current state. Reuse ordinary Append for masks without Append; retain existing AppendFrom/CAS for paragraph appends and all attachment/error semantics. Next: freeze a minimal source candidate plus unchanged-body Linux logical-read regression and immutable35 negative, then independent source review and normal CI. Remaining preflight and writer full-snapshot reads remain explicit; this does not establish targeted corpus-free edits or Mac physical IO recovery. Keep a535 protected-consumer adoption separate; preserve every helper/MCP/session.

ops.text: Independently review minimal EditDoc constant-mask Append versus state-dependent AppendFrom split; preserve operation ordering, errors and text-append CAS, with remaining full-snapshot reads documented.

Pass genuine normal CI with semantic unchanged-body proof, Linux logical-read bound, immutable35 named cost-only negative and existing append/concurrency controls; merge exact accepted source normally.

Publish genuine signed release, perform supported CLI installation with native execution/signature/quarantine and protected-consumer bookends, then independently grade a private installed EditDoc affected case and clean only its owned fixture before normal closure.
